description: Paid (price: see tabularium_menu). Use to back up the memory, take it elsewhere, or hand proof to someone (a principal, an auditor, another agent). Downloads the full history (or entries after `since`) with current values and a signed head, then verifies it offline: hash chain, values against their hashes, and the server's Ed25519 signature. Pass save_to to write the file and get a summary back.

save_to.description: Optional local file path to save the export JSON to

since.description: Only entries with seq > since (incremental export)

name: tabularium_export
title: Export and verify history
